purpose: Complete source-way selection audit explaining the 169-record difference between retained context inventory and emitted Photon street documents; not a status report or address/provider acceptance.
scope: Saved context JSONL, transform provenance sidecar and current parser selection condition only. No PBF scan, transform rerun, dump rewrite, import, HTTP or runtime changes.
method: Read each saved Street context row once, retaining its full source tags and way ID. Compare the complete source ID set with sidecar.streetDocumentSourceWayIds. Evaluate the parser condition: nonblank name, name:he or name:en, plus highway. All omissions have highway but none of those three name keys.

supportedLanguageAliasOnlyLimit.interpretation: The omissions are not all Arabic-only or wholly without Hebrew/English source labels. Explicit alt_name:en/alt_name:he and loc_name:en/loc_name:he labels exist on omitted records. These alternative/local-name-only records are excluded by the current primary-name policy. Numbered keys such as name:en1/name:he1 are retained raw and are not silently reinterpreted as name:en/name:he.

finding.classification: Consistent intentional primary-name eligibility exclusion; no accidental loss of currently eligible primary-name records.
finding.countRecommendation: Use 237207 as the actual transform document count: 125857 houses plus 111350 eligible street documents. Keep 111519 as the full retained source-context inventory.
finding.qualification: This validates the count under the narrow name/name:he/name:en policy, not completeness of all source-supported street aliases. The 19 alternative-name and 4 local-name source ways with explicit supported-language labels are a disclosed coverage gap. No claim that all 169 are unsupported-language-only is justified.
acceptanceLimits: No original-15 quality improvement is established by this audit.
No provider adoption, house identity/precision, import/index completion, full-stack capacity, API integration, p95 or H4 acceptance is established.
Frozen criteria remain unchanged; alias-only exclusions must remain visible in D4.
finding.preservation: Retain all 111519 context street records, the old house dump, current enriched dump and sidecar. Do not rewrite source tags or add names from corpus expectations.
